sources.label: Patches for the Wykop.pl app, for use with Morphe
sources.author: HagiaHaya
patch_list: Keeps the sidebar of the website shown by the app clear of the status bar and the navigation bar.
Allows signing in with Google by using MicroG-RE instead of Google Play services.
Hides the prompt to sign up for the newsletter on the website shown by the app.
Hides ads and blocks ad networks on the website shown by the app.
